verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a public REST API for integrating account data with third-party systems. Through it you can list clients, get client details, retrieve session history, close active sessions, and edit comments and aliases, and an open-source Python module is provided. Its scope is limited to account and session management, it does not drive remote control itself, and no machine-readable spec was found. Missing for 10: OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (probe 404s), API-based session initiation or control, broader write surface (users, address books, configuration), independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use the API to integrate AnyDesk data with third-party systems, for example, to automate billing or collect session logs.
List all AnyDesk clients registered to the account; Get details for a specific client (e.g., Alias, online status)
Retrieve Session History for a selected time range ... Close an active session
Add or update session comments ... Change a client Alias; Remove a client Alias
